Container.Name: sonos_panel
Container.Overview:
Touchscreen-friendly web app for controlling a whole-house Sonos system -- room grouping, volume, favorites/playlists/line-in sources, and a now-playing screensaver. Designed to be installed as a fullscreen PWA on Android/iOS home screens for use as a wall panel, or accessed from any browser on the local network.
IMPORTANT: requires Network Type = Host (set above) for Sonos discovery to work at all -- do not change this to Bridge.
Port 3000 is used by default. If that's already taken on your server, change the Port variable below to any free port -- since this runs in host networking mode (no port mapping/translation), the app will then listen directly on whatever port you set. Note: the WebUI shortcut button below assumes the default (3000); if you change the port, use http://[your-server-ip]:[your-chosen-port]/ directly instead of the shortcut.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Port the app listens on (host networking -- no mapping/translation, this is the actual port on the server itself). Change this if 3000 is already used by something else.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Where config.json (the optional Line-In room override) is stored, so it survives container recreation/updates. Change if you want this somewhere other than the standard appdata location.
